_doc: Gen 1 human enemy roster (ROADMAP §3.6) + encounters. Units: stats, unit tags (Organic/Vehicle plus battle tags), moves (same schema as part moves), koLine (zero death language — soldiers parachute away, vehicles retire loudly), shapes (procedural SVG in unit-local space, viewBox -100 -110 200 220). transformInto = boss second stage. Encounters: ordered wave of unit ids + reward funds. Adding a unit or encounter must never require engine edits. Art (M7.5): organics carry googly eyes under the brim; vehicles get windshield eyes with angry brows — machines are characters too. class: the unit's elemental class for the RPS chart in data/classes.json. tier + tierScale: the difficulty curve. Unit stats (hp/power/armor/stamina) are multiplied by tierScale[tier] at battle time, so one authored roster covers the whole campaign and a later encounter is genuinely harder without duplicating units. tierScale[0] is unused; tier 1 is the tutorial patrol and tier 8 is the Compliance Spire. Rival chimeras carry their own powerScale instead (see rivals.json) and are never tier-scaled. A5: every part listed in a unit's `salvage` has to come off a unit that is actually FIELDED — on a node, in an off-node encounter, or by a director counter-rule. foghorn_array was reachable only from leviathan_dredge, which appears in no encounter at all, so the armour-piercing answer to the Foundry was unobtainable while the balance harness went on benching the Foundry with it.

units.name: Riot Squad
units.koLine: The Riot Squad deploys emergency parachutes. Indoors. It works somehow.

units.name: Net Trooper
units.koLine: The Net Trooper is hoisted away by their own net. Poetic.

units.name: Tranq Team
units.koLine: The Tranq Team accidentally darts itself and naps in a pile.

units.name: Police Cruiser
units.koLine: The Police Cruiser retires loudly, wheels spinning in protest.

units.name: Captain Clampdown
units.koLine: Captain Clampdown is promoted sideways, effective immediately.
units.transformLine: Captain Clampdown slams a big red button: 'ACTIVATE THE 9000!'

units.name: The Clampdown 9000
units.koLine: The Clampdown 9000 ejects its captain into a conveniently placed bouncy castle, then collapses into spare parts.

units.name: Infantry Squad
units.koLine: The Infantry Squad parachutes away in tight formation. Very professional.

units.name: Jeep .50
units.koLine: The Jeep .50 pops all four tires at once and sulks off on the rims.

units.name: Attack Chopper
units.koLine: The Attack Chopper auto-rotates into a haystack. The pilot walks away whistling.

units.name: Harbor Skiff
units.koLine: The Harbor Skiff springs a leak, sighs, and settles into two feet of water.

units.name: Surveillance Drone
units.koLine: The Surveillance Drone lands itself, files a flight report, and powers down in protest.

units.name: Falconry Unit
units.koLine: The Falconry Unit accepts a glove, a snack, and immediate early retirement.

units.name: Gunship 80
units.koLine: Gunship 80 deploys every parachute it has, including several it did not know about.

units.name: Rappel Team
units.koLine: The Rappel Team abseils gently back up its own rope and files for hazard pay.

units.name: Water Cannon Truck
units.koLine: The Water Cannon Truck runs out of water, then out of enthusiasm, and retires loudly.

units.name: Harbor Diver
units.koLine: The Harbor Diver surfaces, gives a cheerful thumbs-up, and floats away on the tide.

units.name: Dredger Barge
units.koLine: The Dredger Barge settles onto a sandbar and retires loudly, with dignity.

units.name: Volunteer Fire Brigade
units.koLine: The Volunteer Fire Brigade coils its hose neatly, waves, and goes back to the pancake breakfast.

units.name: Crop Duster
units.koLine: The Crop Duster lands in a field it was already spraying and taxis away in disgrace.

units.name: Mast Climber
units.koLine: The Mast Climber abseils down at speed, waves, and is not seen again this evening.

units.name: Balloon Relay
units.koLine: The Balloon Relay deflates over four dignified seconds and drapes itself over a barn.

units.name: Aeronaut Prime
units.koLine: Aeronaut Prime hurls the goggles to the deck and reaches, theatrically, for a very large lever.

units.name: Stratofortress
units.koLine: The Stratofortress sheds every panel it owns and glides, with enormous dignity, into a reservoir.

units.name: Sluice Hound
units.koLine: The Sluice Hound is retrieved by its handler, sopping and unrepentant, and taken home for a towel.

units.name: Hydrofoil Lance
units.koLine: The Hydrofoil Lance beaches itself on a boat ramp and idles there, mortified.

units.name: Eel Generator
units.koLine: The Eel Generator trips its own breaker, sighs a shower of sparks, and powers down for the night.

units.name: The Harbormaster
units.koLine: The Harbormaster blows a whistle nobody obeys and climbs, grimly, into something much larger.

units.name: Leviathan Dredge
units.koLine: The Leviathan Dredge settles onto a sandbar and becomes, effective immediately, a wildlife sanctuary.

units.name: Slag Hauler
units.koLine: The Slag Hauler tips its load in the wrong place and retires, loudly, behind a wall of steam.

units.name: Arc Welder Rig
units.koLine: The Arc Welder Rig welds itself to the floor and, on reflection, stays there.

units.name: Foreman Ordnance
units.koLine: Foreman Ordnance files a grievance against your entire existence and clocks out early.

units.name: Smelter Prime
units.koLine: Smelter Prime slams a very red button labelled DO NOT and steps back with obvious relish.

units.name: CRUCIBLE-9000
units.koLine: CRUCIBLE-9000 vents every drop of coolant it owns and retires in a cloud you can see from the ranch.

units.name: Compliance Marshal
units.koLine: The Compliance Marshal serves themself a notice of withdrawal and honours it immediately.

units.name: Mandate Swarm
units.koLine: The Mandate Swarm runs out of battery mid-sentence and rains gently into a hedge.

units.name: Audit Diver
units.koLine: The Audit Diver surfaces, gives a thumbs up nobody asked for, and is towed away by a colleague.

units.name: Director Prime
units.koLine: Director Prime declares the meeting adjourned and descends, on a platform, into the floor.

units.name: THE COMPLIANCE ENGINE
units.koLine: THE COMPLIANCE ENGINE files for an extension, is denied, and shuts down in alphabetical order.

units.name: Gantry Crane
units.koLine: The Gantry Crane drops everything it is holding, including its own hook, and parks itself at the far wall.

units.name: Quench Rig
units.koLine: The Quench Rig boils itself dry, emits one enormous sigh of steam, and retires behind the cloud.

encounters.name: Precinct Patrol
encounters.blurb: Two officers investigating 'suspicious kazoo noises.'

encounters.name: Downtown Response
encounters.blurb: The city upgraded its concern to a cruiser.

encounters.name: Captain Clampdown
encounters.blurb: The precinct's finest, plus whatever is under that tarp.

encounters.name: Highway Checkpoint
encounters.blurb: Cones. So many cones.

encounters.name: Military Response
encounters.blurb: Gen 2: the professionals have professional opinions about your goat.

encounters.name: Evidence Impound Lot
encounters.blurb: Behind enemy lines. Your creature is in cell block C, past the vending machine.

encounters.name: Air Patrol
encounters.blurb: They called in something with rotors.

encounters.name: Harbor Watch
encounters.blurb: The county remembered it owns a boat.

encounters.name: Crop-Duster Strip
encounters.blurb: A grass runway, two hangars, and a great deal of unearned confidence.

encounters.name: Radio Mast
encounters.blurb: Whoever holds the mast holds the weather report, and thus morale.

encounters.name: Cloudbase Depot
encounters.blurb: Everything here is bolted to the ceiling, which should have been a clue.

encounters.name: The Aerodrome
encounters.blurb: Aeronaut Prime has a scarf, a hangar, and something enormous under a tarp.

encounters.name: Sunken Marina
encounters.blurb: The pontoons are underneath the boats now. Nobody wants to discuss it.

encounters.name: Spillway Locks
encounters.blurb: Whoever owns the locks owns which streets are streets today.

encounters.name: Dredge Yard
encounters.blurb: They have wired the whole yard to the water. On purpose. Bring boots.

encounters.name: Harbormaster's Rig
encounters.blurb: The Harbormaster has a whistle, a grudge, and a crane the size of a church.

encounters.name: Slag Gate
encounters.blurb: A gate made of gates. The foreman has laminated the rules.

encounters.name: Rolling Mill
encounters.blurb: Everything in here is either red hot or armour-plated. Frequently both.

encounters.name: The Motor Pool
encounters.blurb: Every vehicle you have ever annoyed, parked in tidy rows, freshly painted.

encounters.name: Crucible Floor
encounters.blurb: Smelter Prime pours a fresh chassis while you watch. It is meant for you.

encounters.name: Spire Reception
encounters.blurb: Please take a number. The number is a summons.

encounters.name: Records Annex
encounters.blurb: Every unkind thing anyone has written about you, alphabetised.

encounters.name: Rooftop Pad
encounters.blurb: The helipad, the water tanks, and a really committed accountant.

encounters.name: The Boardroom
encounters.blurb: Director Prime would like to walk you through the slides. All of them.
